trust_boundary.runtime: Captured compiler/std, safe collection/storage contracts, canonical arbitrary-precision Q arithmetic/GCD and checked BasicMatrix. The complete renamed Carrier context preserves the nominal cycle and is independently reversed/checked; no surrogate providers or visibility widening.

Nine known-rank carriers check exact domain constants, dimensions/ranks, separate matrix/weight fingerprints, carrier framing, getters, clone/equality, serialization and custom AsRef transport. Independent alterations of all ten stored components must fail verifies, as must a different carrier. Twelve constant/role/getter/verification faults are detected.
G2: Every field is copied/computed from the same once-observed admitted Carrier. Its matrix/weight data are already canonical; the lower hash functions have separate explicit source/mutation/framing assessments. The derived full-record comparison checks ranks/version/dimensions as well as hashes, so a matching digest alone does not verify a forged record.

Rank metadata is not included as a separate input to the carrier digest because it is mathematically determined by the bound matrices and independently checked at Carrier admission. verifies still compares those stored ranks explicitly. No collision-impossibility or author-authentication theorem is inferred. Literal metadata transport is modeled only as raw preservation.
G3: Private immutable fields, lack of Deserialize, exact typed getters and recomputation prevent safe external field/wire tampering from bypassing a verification result. Only admitted Carrier values are read; no raw rational arithmetic/admission boundary is crossed.

Hash/library allocation and caller-supplied AsRef/serializer behavior are explicit runtime contracts. from_carrier invokes AsRef once, stores owned fingerprints/data and has no error-swallowing or partial mathematical-result path.
G5: Seven explicit functions have CCN 1, cognitive 0 and nesting 0. from_carrier hashes each required matrix/weight once; getters are fixed-field observations. verifies performs one explicit whole-receipt recomputation and comparison, not hidden rank recomputation. Encoding work is linear in coefficient bit/byte volume; no recursive path or redundant inner-loop collection allocation appears.

formal_specification.domain: An admitted local Carrier returned by its own checked constructor, or a caller AsRef yielding one. Manifest fields are private, immutable, Clone/Eq/Serialize only; no untrusted wire admission is provided.
formal_specification.delivered_behavior: Store version 1, exact three dimensions, two already checked ranks, canonical matrix/weight fingerprints and their domain-framed carrier digest. Observers read named fields. verifies recomputes all fields and compares the whole record. Constants specify Q/BigRational domain, not authentication.
formal_specification.failure: No new mathematical admission is attempted; this computed receipt relies on an admitted Carrier. Arbitrary caller AsRef/serializer follows its trait contract, and wire serialization alone cannot construct a verified manifest.

invariant_argument: AsRef yields one immutable admitted local Carrier. Exact getters and deterministic separately assessed framing/hash functions populate every private field from that same instance; full record equality is the verifies predicate. No output claims that a hash or serialized field certifies mathematics by itself.

The canonical Carrier admission/certificate invariants justify recording its rank/dimension metadata. The independent field/constant/getter/tamper tests bind literal transport; ScalarAdmission.store_preserves is used only for that literal-storage claim, not as a rank/hash theorem.

failure_paths.trusted_input: Admitted Carrier has canonical coefficient and rank invariants. External AsRef may choose any admitted Carrier under its trait contract; its arbitrary user code is not certified here.
failure_paths.serialization: Derived Serialize emits raw receipt fields and can propagate caller serializer behavior; there is no Deserialize/unchecked wire constructor.
failure_paths.verification: Recompute once and compare every field; return false on each distinct tamper or differing admitted carrier. No fallback digest-only acceptance or authority promotion.

consumer_review: The direct local Carrier::manifest and compatibility facades produce this receipt; hashing uses its exact version/domain constants. The native full context preserves this nominal cycle rather than substituting a stand-in Carrier.
